name: depphunter
description: Browse the workspace as an interactive isometric city, in the editor's built-in browser.

commands.title: Open the Map in the Browser
Show the Finding on the Map

depphunter.path.markdownDescription: The `depphunter` binary to run. **Leave it empty** to use the one the extension ships with - a released build carries the binary for your platform, pinned to the same version - falling back to `depphunter` on `PATH` for a build that carries none. Set it only to point at a different build: a bare name is looked up on `PATH`, an absolute path is used as given.

enumDescriptions: A tab of the editor's own. The only one where walk mode can capture the mouse.
The editor's built-in browser, which has an address bar but withholds the pointer lock.
The default browser, outside the editor.

depphunter.watch.description: Re-analyze on file changes and update the map live (--watch).

depphunter.config.markdownDescription: A config file to use instead of the folder's own `.depphunter.yaml` (`--config`), relative to the folder. Unlike the folder's file, one named here may set `editor` and `online`.

depphunter.editorCommand.markdownDescription: What the map's "Open in editor" button runs, e.g. `code -g {file}:{line}`. Empty means this editor, when its command-line launcher can be found, and otherwise whatever depphunter detects.

depphunter.args.markdownDescription: Further arguments, one per entry, passed after everything the settings above produce, e.g. `["--exclude", "vendor"]`. Run `depphunter --help` for the list.

depphunter.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs of paths to skip (`--exclude`), added to those the config files name, e.g. `vendor` or `**/*.gen.go`.

depphunter.maxFileSize.markdownDescription: Files larger than this many bytes are not read (`--max-file-size`). Empty leaves it to the config files and the default. (2 MiB).

depphunter.resolveDepth.markdownDescription: Levels of dependencies-of-dependencies to resolve from lock files (`--resolve-depth`): `0` none, `-1` as far as they reach. Empty leaves it to the config files and the default.

depphunter.online.markdownDescription: Ask package indexes about dependencies the project's files do not record, and the OSV database about pinned packages (`--online`). Analysis is offline without it.

depphunter.cache.markdownDescription: Read and write the analysis cache. Unticked passes `--no-cache`.

depphunter.history.markdownDescription: Read git history for the commits, churn, age and authors overlays. Unticked passes `--no-history`.

depphunter.historyCommits.markdownDescription: Read at most this many commits of git history (`--history-commits`). Empty leaves it to the config files and the default. (10000).

depphunter.private.markdownDescription: Globs naming the packages your organization owns (`--private`), written the way `GOPRIVATE` writes them: `corp.example/*`, `npm:@acme/*`, `oci:harbor.corp/*`. Nothing matched is asked of a public index or sent to the OSV database - the request itself would say that an internal package exists, and to whom. `GOPRIVATE` and `GONOPROXY` are read on top of this, so Go projects usually need nothing here.

depphunter.explain.markdownDescription: Write the resolution report to the depphunter output channel whenever the map is built (`--explain`): which index each package resolves from and who named it, what each level of `#depphunter.resolveDepth#` asked and what answered, and every question that came back with nothing, with the reason. The same report is a document at any time through **depphunter: Show the Resolution Report**.

depphunter.trustIndexes.markdownDescription: Index URLs to treat as though this machine configured them (`--trust-index`), e.g. `https://nexus.corp/repository/npm-group`. An index only the repository names is otherwise marked **⚠ index** and never fetched from, which is the dependency-confusion guard; this is how to say that one of them is yours.

enumDescriptions: Whatever the config files say, or a city.
depphunter.style.markdownDescription: What the map is dressed as. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.theme.markdownDescription: The map's color theme; `auto` follows the system. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.colorBy.markdownDescription: What colors the buildings. All but `language` and `size` need git history. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.heightScale.markdownDescription: How lines of code turn into building height. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.expandDepth.markdownDescription: How many directory levels start expanded: `0` picks for you, `-1` expands everything. Empty leaves it to the repository and the default. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.showStd.markdownDescription: Show standard-library islands. Where the repository has saved a view of its own, that view wins: this is what a map opens at before anyone has saved one in it.

depphunter.findings.markdownDescription: Scanner reports to place on the map (`--findings`), relative to the folder: govulncheck, npm audit, trivy, golangci-lint, eslint or osv-scanner JSON. Globs are allowed.

depphunter.vulns.markdownDescription: Place scanner reports on the map and, with `#depphunter.online#`, ask the OSV database. Unticked passes `--no-vulns`.

depphunter.links.markdownDescription: Follow the links the folder's Markdown carries and report the ones that lead nowhere - a file that is not there, a heading that is not in it, a reference nobody defined. It needs nothing but the folder, so it is on by default; with `#depphunter.online#`, `http(s)` links are asked about as well. Unticked passes `--no-links`.

depphunter.lsp.markdownDescription: Find symbol references with the language servers installed on this machine - gopls and the like (`--lsp`). Slow on a large repository.

depphunter.lspTimeout.markdownDescription: Time budget for the language servers (`--lsp-timeout`), e.g. `90s` or `10m`. Empty leaves it to the config files and the default. (5m).
